# Temple Scroll Column 65 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 11Q19 (Cave 11), Col. 65 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**65:1** The priests, the Levites — all the tribe of Levi — shall have no portion or inheritance with Israel. The fire offerings of the LORD and his inheritance they shall eat.

**65:2** And they shall have no inheritance in the midst of their brothers; the LORD is their inheritance, as he spoke to them.

**65:3** And this shall be the due of the priests from the people, from those who slaughter a slaughter-offering, whether ox or sheep: they shall give to the priest the shoulder and the two cheeks and the stomach.

**65:4** The firstfruits of your grain, your new wine, and your fresh oil, and the first of the shearing of your flock you shall give to him.

**65:5** For him the LORD your God has chosen out of all your tribes, to stand to minister in the name of the LORD, him and his sons, all the days.

**65:6** And if a Levite comes from one of your gates, from all Israel where he sojourns, and he comes with all the desire of his soul to the place that I shall choose,

**65:7** then he shall minister in the name of the LORD his God like all his brothers the Levites who stand there before me.

**65:8** Portion for portion they shall eat, besides what comes from the sale of his patrimony.

**65:9** When you come into the land that I am giving to you, you shall not learn to do according to the abominations of those nations.

**65:10** There shall not be found among you one who makes his son or his daughter pass through the fire, one who practices divination, a soothsayer, or an augur, or a sorcerer,

**65:11** or one who casts spells, or one who inquires of a ghost or a familiar spirit, or one who seeks out the dead.

**65:12** For an abomination to the LORD is everyone who does these things, and on account of these abominations the LORD your God is dispossessing them from before you.

**65:13** You shall be whole-hearted with the LORD your God.

**65:14** For these nations that you are about to dispossess listen to soothsayers and to diviners, but as for you — not so has the LORD your God given to you.

**65:15** A prophet from your midst, from your brothers, like me, shall the LORD your God raise up for you; to him you shall listen.

**65:16** According to all that you asked from the LORD your God at Horeb on the day of the assembly, saying: Let me not hear again the voice of the LORD my God, and this great fire let me not see again, lest I die.

---

*EMET notes: Column 65 reworks Deut 18:1–16. Priestly portions (shoulder, cheeks, stomach) preserved literally. "Fire offerings" for אשי maintains cultic terminology. "Whole-hearted" for תמים — not "blameless" or "perfect" but relationally complete. The prophet-like-Moses oracle (65:15) is one of the most important messianic proof-texts in Second Temple Judaism. "From your midst, from your brothers" preserves the double prepositional phrase. "Horeb" preserved (not "Sinai") as in Deuteronomic tradition.*
